tools.name: scan_workflow
tools.description:
Scan one n8n workflow JSON export (string) and return the findings report.

Accepts the raw workflow object ({'nodes': [...], ...}) or the CLI export
wrapper ({'name':..., 'workflow': {...}}). Max 512 KB.
